[12160.332461] LustreError: 340572:0:(osd_handler.c:4158:osd_destroy()) LBUG

these messages are directly related with assertion, so in code:

	if (!S_ISDIR(attr->la_mode) || sbuf->lb_buf) {
		mdd_write_lock(env, sobj, DT_SRC_CHILD);
		rc = mdo_ref_del(env, sobj, handle);
		if (!rc) {
			if (S_ISDIR(attr->la_mode))
				rc = mdo_ref_del(env, sobj, handle);
			if (!rc)
				rc = mdo_destroy(env, sobj, handle);
		...

the very first ref_del() discovers that object has nlink == 0 already, but returns 0 due to some compatibility code, so goes further to assertion in destroy(). laisiyao can you check this, is it possible situation that after getting write lock sobj can be deleted already? Then we need to check that first probably. Or maybe the reason is something else?

I wonder if this is enough to fix:

diff --git a/lustre/osd-ldiskfs/osd_handler.c b/lustre/osd-ldiskfs/osd_handler.c
index 7535b91ef2..12b2414d50 100644
--- a/lustre/osd-ldiskfs/osd_handler.c
+++ b/lustre/osd-ldiskfs/osd_handler.c
@@ -4755,7 +4755,7 @@ static int osd_ref_del(const struct lu_env *env, struct dt_object *dt,
        struct osd_device *osd = osd_dev(dt->do_lu.lo_dev);
        struct osd_thandle *oh;
 
-       if (!dt_object_exists(dt))
+       if (!dt_object_exists(dt) || obj->oo_destroyed)
                return -ENOENT;
 
        LINVRNT(osd_invariant(obj));

basically that makes osd_ref_del() to be in sync with other calls and with its ZFS variant

"Mikhail Pershin <mpershin@whamcloud.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/64650
